latestVersion.changelog:
Editor de Video Gratis — Edit and export videos for free on cloud GPUs

- First release: edit, process, and export video clips up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) into 1080p MP4s.
- Easy onboarding: connect instantly with a free starter token (100 credits, 7-day expiry) — no registration required.
- Upload, edit, check credits/status, and export videos from chat; works for content creators and students.
- 1–2 minute cloud render pipeline with clear status, timeline preview, and automatic error handling.
- Supports adding/removing video, audio, and text tracks with intent classification of user messages.
- Guidance and troubleshooting included for common errors, file types, and workflow improvements.
